_comment: Programs that should open on the MAIN screen instead of the Onn. PCDash moves each new window of these once, when it appears; drag it back and it stays. Match by exe name, or by a piece of the program's folder path. Edit, then Quit + reopen PCDash from the tray.
_games_borderless: true: a game that opens as a normal window (title bar + taskbar) is made borderless fullscreen. false to turn off.
